title: m3 production gpu develop for export

commit.merge_subject: merge: m3 production gpu develop for export

description:
The 69723d5 "render backend: requested=... effective=... unsupported=..."
line's effective= is now the DEVELOP axis, truthfully: GLES when the GPU
develop session rendered the frames, CPU otherwise. The line moves from
before the encode loop to the big try's finally because the develop axis
is only knowable after the frames have rendered — a mid-render GPU
failure latches the CPU develop mid-stream, so a pre-loop line would
have promised GLES and delivered CPU. The finally covers success,
mid-encode failure, and finish() failure alike; the one path it stays
silent on is a writer.start() throw — that attempt never began, and the
exporter's SurfaceInputUnavailable restart re-runs with its own line,
so the restart still reads one line per export.

The encoder-input mode is now its OWN unconditional line — "encoder
input: surface" when the writer took the Surface mode, "encoder input:
bytes"
changed: feat: gpu develop session (production, not parity-harness)
feat: export dispatches gpu develop when covered
feat: export log reports develop backend truthfully
